title: Convergent Performance, Divergent Mechanisms in LoRA-Adapted Vision Foundation Models for Brain MRI
abstract: arXiv:2610.28255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: seg

translated_title: LoRA适配的视觉基础模型在脑部MRI中的性能趋同与机制分化
translated_abstract: 通过LoRA将视觉基础模型（VFMs）适配到医学影像领域已成为标准做法，然而模型选择几乎完全由下游任务指标驱动，性能相近的骨干网络往往被视为可互换的。我们研究了相同的性能是否意味着相同的内部表征变化。我们分析了四个ViT-B/16骨干网络——DINOv3、SigLIP2、MerMED-FM和BiomedCLIP——它们分别采用不同的预训练目标（自蒸馏 vs. 对比式视觉-语言学习）和不同的数据域（自然图像 vs. 医学图像）进行预训练。我们将每个模型适配到脑肿瘤分割任务，并在涵盖分割任务与阿尔茨海默病分类的六个数据集上进行评估。通过注意力分歧分析、权重变化分析和激活修补（activation patching）方法，我们发现这四个模型通过截然不同的内部动态收敛到相似的分割性能（平均Dice系数78-81%），但在跨任务迁移方面表现出现分化：（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 研究发现，不同预训练目标的视觉基础模型经LoRA适配后，在脑部MRI分割任务上虽取得几乎相同的性能，但其内部表征变化机制截然不同，且跨任务迁移能力存在显著差异。
en_tdlr: Vision foundation models with different pretraining objectives converge to nearly identical LoRA-adapted segmentation performance on brain MRI, yet exhibit markedly divergent internal mechanisms and cross-task transfer capabilities.
